title: salvia yangii
intro: Salvia yangii, commonly known as Yangii Sage or Chinese Sage, is a perennial plant species in the mint family, native to China. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cognitive function, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins that have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective properties. Salvia yangii is also used in traditional medicine to treat various conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems.
